	| list |
	list := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	list add: { 'amount' -> amount. 'category' -> category } asDictionary.
	^ list size

total
	^ (state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) inject: 0 into: [ :sum :e | sum + (e at: 'amount') ]

by_category
	| out |
	out := Dictionary new.
	(state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) do: [ :e |
		out at: (e at: 'category') put: (out at: (e at: 'category') ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) + (e at: 'amount') ].
	^ out

total
	^ self cents: ((state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) inject: 0 into: [ :sum :e | sum + (e at: 'amount') ])

by_category
	| out |
	out := Dictionary new.
	(state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) do: [ :e |
		out at: (e at: 'category') put: (self cents: (out at: (e at: 'category') ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) + (e at: 'amount')) ].
	^ out

add_expense: amount category: category
	| list |
	(amount isNumber and: [ amount > 0 ]) ifFalse: [ ^ self error: 'amount must be positive' ].
	(category isString and: [ category isEmpty not ]) ifFalse: [ ^ self error: 'category required' ].
	list := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	list add: { 'amount' -> amount. 'category' -> category } asDictionary.
	^ list size

set_budget: category amount: amount
	(state at: 'budgets' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ]) at: category put: amount.
	^ amount

over_budget
	| spent budgets |
	spent := self by_category.
	budgets := state at: 'budgets' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ].
	^ (budgets keys select: [ :c | (spent at: c ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) > (budgets at: c) ]) sorted

top_category
	| spent best |
	spent := self by_category.
	best := nil.
	spent keys sorted do: [ :c | (best isNil or: [ (spent at: c) > (spent at: best) ]) ifTrue: [ best := c ] ].
	^ best

add_expense: amount category: category note: note
	| list entry |
	(amount isNumber and: [ amount > 0 ]) ifFalse: [ ^ self error: 'amount must be positive' ].
	(category isString and: [ category isEmpty not ]) ifFalse: [ ^ self error: 'category required' ].
	list := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	entry := { 'amount' -> amount. 'category' -> category } asDictionary.
	note isNil ifFalse: [ entry at: 'note' put: note ].
	list add: entry.
	^ list size

add_expense: amount category: category
	^ self add_expense: amount category: category note: nil

add_expense: amount category: category
	| list |
	list := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	list add: { 'amount' -> amount negated. 'category' -> category } asDictionary.
	^ list size
